card.name: Endings of azole drug names
card.fires_on: The final piece "azole" (sometimes "ate" or "amine") that completes a chemical or drug class name, such as nitroimidazole, benzimidazole, sulfaphenazole or itraconazole.

modes.label: azole endings
modes.description: The closing "azole" piece of antifungal, antiparasitic or sulfonamide drug and class names.

modes.label: other chemical endings
modes.description: The closing "ate" or "amine" piece of a longer chemical name.

card.plain: It fires at the end of a long drug or chemical name, most often the "-azole" in names like nitroimidazole.
